note: P4147 (Pro 20:25) — it is a snare to say rashly, 'It is holy,' and reflect only after vowing.

dims.v: rash consecration — a snare to vow 'holy' hastily
the rash saying 'it is holy' (a hasty vow of dedication) that becomes a snare, reflected on only afterward
the hasty dedication that entangles the vower

qodesh (holy/consecrated) — 'it is a snare to say rashly, It is HOLY, and to reflect only after making vows'; hasty consecration/vowing is a trap. The read warns against rash dedication — count the cost before vowing, not after (cf Eccl 5:4-5).
